description: Scanned-synthesis oscillator: a row of masses on springs vibrates far below hearing, and the shape it makes is read round at audio rate to give the tone, so the timbre keeps moving on its own

params.text: Sets how fast the string's shape is read round, which is the pitch: roughly 16Hz at the bottom of its travel to 4000Hz at the top
Trims the pitch, seven semitones either way
Sets the weight of the masses: heavy and slow at the bottom of its travel, light and volatile at the top
Sets how hard the springs pull one mass towards the next: higher couples them more tightly and brings out metallic, inharmonic partials
Sets how fast the motion bleeds away: short percussive decays at the bottom of its travel, long sustains close to self-oscillation at the top
Sets how hard every mass is pulled back to the centre line; higher speeds the motion up and reshapes the harmonics
Morphs the hammer profile used to hit the string, from a sine through a sawtooth and noise to a pair of pulses
Drives the string continuously with the hammer profile, 0 to 1; at the bottom it only rings from a hit or from the inject jack, and above that it sustains on its own
Sets how often the string physics are stepped, 500Hz at the bottom of its travel to 8000Hz at the top; every other control's effect changes with it
Attenuates the signal at the inject jack before it drives the string, 0 to 1
Hammers every mass to the hammer profile, a pluck

inputs.text: Added to the freq and fine knobs, one volt per octave
A rising edge through 1V hammers every mass to the hammer profile, a pluck
A signal that drives the string through the hammer profile, scaled by the in lvl knob; it behaves a little like an envelope follower
Added to the mass knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the stiff knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the damp knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the cntr knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the shape knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the strg knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the rate knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it

outputs.text: The scanned string, ±5V, through a limiter that holds the level steady across the whole range of the controls

notes: with strength at the bottom and nothing patched, the string is at exact rest and the output is silent. Press excite, patch a trigger into exc, or raise strength.
the lamp beside the output follows its level.
